listings.name: Telegram
listings.line: Message Letronna from a Telegram chat and get answers back. Files, photos and voice notes go both ways.

listings.name: GitHub
listings.line: Repositories, issues and pull requests, as far as your token can see and change them.

listings.name: ChatGPT
listings.line: The Codex models your ChatGPT plan includes, signed in with ChatGPT instead of an API key.

listings.name: Discord
listings.line: Talk to Letronna through a bot of your own, in a direct message or in a server.

listings.name: Slack
listings.line: Talk to Letronna in a direct message, or mention it in a channel.

listings.name: Linear
listings.line: Your workspace’s issues, projects and comments, to read and to write.

listings.name: Notion
listings.line: The pages and databases you share with it, to read and to edit.

listings.name: Sentry
listings.line: The errors and issues in your Sentry projects, where Letronna can look into them.

listings.name: Stripe
listings.line: Customers, payments, invoices and products, as far as your sign-in allows.

listings.name: Filesystem
listings.line: The files in a folder you name, through the reference MCP server.

listings.name: Claude
listings.line: The models your Claude subscription includes, signed in with Claude instead of an API key.

listings.name: Discord Rich Presence
listings.line: Show Letronna on your Discord profile while you work.

listings.name: Letronna
listings.line: Letronna itself: its commands, settings, chat apps and MCP servers, for when you ask how to do something.

listings.name: Frontend design
listings.line: Guidance for visual design with a point of view, when building an interface or reshaping one.

listings.name: Web app testing
listings.line: Tests a web app running on your computer: checks the interface, takes screenshots, reads the browser’s logs.

listings.name: MCP builder
listings.line: A guide to building MCP servers whose tools a model can use well.

listings.name: Skill creator
listings.line: Writes new skills, improves the ones you have, and measures how they do.

listings.name: PDF
listings.line: Reads PDF files, pulls out their text and tables, merges, splits and fills them in.

listings.name: Word documents
listings.line: Creates, reads and edits Word documents.

listings.name: Zed
listings.line: Run Letronna as the agent inside Zed, over the Agent Client Protocol.

listings.name: JetBrains
listings.line: Run Letronna as the agent inside JetBrains editors, over the Agent Client Protocol.
